QUOTE: "The code message says a rebuild cannot fix it and the MCP client must be restarted." and "A write from a process that predates its source is refused ... The refusal exists because a stale process once rebuilt an index at an older version and dropped a layer."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer covers the code-axis refusal on writes, but it never says reads stay current because query tools open the database per call, so the read/write asymmetry is absent.
